identityReviewRetry.observedSource: The native portrait shows a middle-aged man, stored age 44, with a long oval face, fairly broad forehead and a substantial tapered lower face ending in a rounded chin. His cheeks have ordinary fullness rather than sharp hollows. The eyes are warm hazel-brown, medium-size almond shapes with slightly hooded lids and nearly level outer corners. Thick dark eyebrows are relatively straight with restrained outer arches, separated by a clear gap. The nose has a fairly long straight bridge, broad rounded tip and moderate nostrils. Lips are medium width with a thin upper lip and fuller lower lip, closed neutrally. Skin is fair-to-light warm beige, with mild reddish variation at the cheeks and nose, fine forehead creases and subtle under-eye lines. No distinct scar, tattoo or conspicuous acne cluster is visible. Hair is dark brown, medium length, with a mild wave, swept backward from a central descending widow's peak. The sides extend down around the ears and the back reaches the nape; preserve this longer ear-framing silhouette rather than a close crop or a tight curl cap. A few flyaways appear near the temples. Facial hair is sparse short dark stubble across the jaw and chin, a thin irregular moustache and a small separate patch below the lower lip; cheeks stay mostly clean. Keep the high forehead, hazel gaze, back-swept ear-length hair and light stubble pattern. Exact hair length at the hidden nape is somewhat uncertain.
